For men and guys we have another camp for intermediate riders who want to move a bit further off-road. We'll cover the skills centre and pump track in the morning, as well as jumps, technical climbs, descents and simply everything you might encounter off-road. The locations will differ a bit from this year's first camp.

LOCATION:

The Tehov leisure park and its surroundings are a great place to learn something. In cooperation with the municipality of Tehov, the local park was built and developed for leisure activities, including cycling. The technical trail will help us practise handling berms, rock gardens, sharp corners and other features you may come across off-road.

On the pump track you'll practise pumping and flow, and for the more skilled we have small jumps ready. We can practise riding without pedalling, riding rhythm, pedal position in corners, or riding properly fast.

There are also Trial obstacles – in other words, what to avoid and what to try riding over on a ride.

You can also get to the park by train from Světice or Říčany station. You can also ride to us directly from Prague along the Kolovraty – Mnichovice cycle path, turning off in Světice.

SUITABLE FOR:

Boys, men and gentlemen aged 18+, or younger by arrangement if accompanied by parents (ideally also men). Any groups will be divided by ability or focus. In terms of ability, it's suitable for intermediate and more advanced off-road riders.

Intermediate level means – I ride off-road and can handle a regular trail, but I want to improve. Polish my basic technique, ride berms with confidence, enjoy all kinds of terrain and, if I feel like it, try jumps and drops or anything more demanding that comes up.

WHAT WE HAVE READY FOR YOU:


We'd love to write 'a great lunch with wine, beer or soft drinks', but you know how it is. We'll order food for delivery together.

We ask all participants to take a Covid-19 test.

SUNDAY – 3 October

07:30 – 08:00  Riders arrive, registration and equipment check with bike setup

08:30 – 09:00  Introduction of instructors, information about the coaching and splitting into groups

09:00 – 13:00 Technique training in the park, from the flat to the pump track and obstacles

13:00 – 14:30 Workshop focused on the bike and equipment + lunch break, digestion and discussion (simply a chat about bikes and riding)

14:30 – 18:00 Ride around the area with off-road training

18:30 – 19:30 Camp review, tips and so on …

CAPACITY, BOOKING AND PAYMENT TERMS:

Camps have limited capacity. You can check availability in the header of the camp description (booked / total capacity), as well as the price. Your companions can attend, but we'll primarily focus on you and the other paying riders.

Bookings can be made using the form on this page or by e-mail to info@bikeskills.cz. Confirmation from us is required. We'll send you an invoice right away (within 48 hrs). Payment must be made by the due date stated on the invoice.

Cancellation is possible for a fee of 50% of the total camp price 14 days before the event, or 90% of the total camp price 13 days or less before the event. Or by arrangement (injury, illness, force majeure).

By paying and attending the event, participants confirm that they take part at their own risk. The organiser is not responsible for loss of or damage to property.
